mapper.sql: id, user_id, systolic, diastolic, blood_sugar, heart_rate, weight, bmi, memo, recorded_time, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_record (user_id, systolic, diastolic, blood_sugar, heart_rate, weight, bmi, memo, recorded_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{systolic}, #{diastolic}, #{bloodSugar}, #{heartRate}, #{weight}, #{bmi}, #{memo}, #{recordedTime})
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM health_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY recorded_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT
FROM health_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND recorded_time >= #{startTime} ORDER BY recorded_time ASC, id ASC
